plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he saw signs of implants in a man named Eric Mitchell. He says that recently they also found dyes on them, which he links to aliens. If true, it would be physical evidence that someone had been marked or tagged by non-human beings.
